table.reason: Interactive table editing, sorting, expansion and action bindings.

num.reason: Editable numeric input with drag, keyboard, units, expressions and undo.

pick.reason: Weighted multi-criterion comparison, scoring and selection state.

troubleshoot.reason: Branching diagnostic graph with history, completion and action controls.

ask.reason: Multi-field form renderer, validation, conditional fields and submission state.

datatable.reason: Sortable, selectable, virtualized data grid with streaming, animation and accessibility.

chart.reason: Interactive SVG renderer for four chart types, streaming domains, pivots and accessibility.

artifact.reason: Sandbox/compiler plus deferred graphic feedback and mockup engines; all lazy JS is charged.

mockup.reason: Wireframe renderer, sandbox messaging, drawing, annotations and feedback history.

view.reason: Recursive bound UI renderer and styled primitives, expressions and event handlers.

shared.reason: All frame/controls, utilities, eager grammars, strings, tokens and common styles, once.

react.reason: Shared React renderer, motion, themes, markdown and integration prompt API.

core.reason: Streaming Markdown, directives, JSON and parser plugins.

state.reason: Shared state, patch, undo and persistence runtime.

schema.reason: Shared schema and prompt documentation runtime.
